_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Denial with flat 30d return and muted funding—coil base rate favors HOLD; bottom analog only permits a +1 rung drift to Anxiety if range holds, not a skip to Disbelief.
next_move.brains_agree: No—analyst explicitly HOLD/coil; narrative supplies flow color only and does not confirm a directional breaker
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, phase score remains near Denial–Anxiety band, funding stays muted
next_move.invalidated_if: decisive range break with ETF-flow revival plus momentum expansion (up) or long-unwind with skew/funding stress (down)
